name: Roblox-inspired world
description: A bright block-toy world: soft plastic bricks, stud-textured baseplate, tidy houses, fences, block trees and drifting block clouds, with a chunky block character whose painted face really acts. Story and 'did you know' videos.
rules: Everything is a soft-edged plastic brick: no thin geometry, no realistic textures.
Studs on the ground and a few props; flat saturated colour blocking; sun from the front-left with a soft shadow.
The character is rigid like a toy (shoulders and hips turn, no elbows or knees) but the painted face does the acting: eyes, brows, mouth.
Environment tells the story: a tower grows, a storm darkens the sky, doors open. Props move; the character does not teleport.
One-word captions in yellow with a thick dark outline, sitting below the chest.
Keep the camera low-key: moves only for reveals.
camera_language: Low, friendly eye-level; wide to show the world and the character in it, medium-wide three-quarter for actions so the arm and the object are both visible, close-up on the painted face for emotion. Blocky bodies are wide: over-the-shoulder needs the camera 2.5 m back.
audio_direction: light bed, whoosh on every camera move, pop on reveals
pitfalls: The wide torso blocks the object in over-the-shoulder: use medium-wide three-quarter.
The cap hides the brows in extreme close-ups: stay at medium-close-up or wider.
Bright sky washes out yellow captions: keep the dark outline at 12 px or more.
